svg.title: Red Chun above a red cat silhouette, without the circle
svg.desc: The upper Chun glyph is retained. The lower red cat keeps the white head, body and tail region from the existing Invertocat artwork; the black circle is removed. This modified artwork is not a new official logo or endorsed product. Removing the circle and changing color does not establish permission for this use. See ASSET-LICENSES.md.
